about_the_game:
Save the princesses at all costs as you infiltrate castles filled with treacherous foes!

Step into the armored boots of an overzealous knight as you fight across the continent rescuing princesses from their monstrous captors in Tiny Pixels Vol. 2 - Stormy Knights! Strategic real-time combat ensues as you crash the gates and storm the halls of each castle in side-scrolling pixel art style, from medieval Europe and mystical Persia to feudal Japan and more, all accompanied by an original retro soundtrack! Watch your foes carefully to break down their tactics and predict their attacks.

Slash, dodge, defend and overcome minions like goblins and lizardmen to reach the boss of the castle, and if you emerge victorious, you’ll win the affection of a fair maiden imprisoned within. Each run is unique, with different princesses to find and rescue each time! Collect valuable golden medals to purchase perpetual upgrades across 3 skill trees and stack the deck in your favor for subsequent runs. How long can you keep up this personal crusade as you survive against seemingly impossible odds? Push through an infinite loop of challenges to see how many castles you can storm, with loads of fun stats to track your knightly progress!

Features:

  • Take the role of a valiant knight determined to rescue every princess in distress!

  • Slash, dodge and block enemy attacks using your sword and shield.

  • Observe enemy movements and strategically dispatch them in real-time encounters!

  • Face off against brutal bosses in each enemy stronghold!

  • Collect golden medals to purchase upgrades across 3 skill trees.

  • Enjoy a blood-pumping retro soundtrack and fluidly animated pixel art!

  • See how long you can survive an infinite game loop!
